campaign.name: Ashes of Kestrel Vale
campaign.logline: Heroes in a drowned river valley uncover that the laws protecting civilization were built to hide an engineered cataclysm.

entries.note: Kestrel Vale uses stamped copper reeds for local trade. The Salt Guild manipulates salt access, bridge tariffs, and debt notes to control farmers, river merchants, and barge crews.
entries.summary: Kestrel Vale uses stamped copper reeds for local trade. The Salt Guild manipulates salt access, bridge tariffs, and debt notes to control farmers, river merchants, and barge crews.

entries.note: Session 2 — The Salt Guild Ledger: The party stole a Salt Guild ledger proving illegal bridge fees. Bromm identified old clan marks in the margin that reference Bell Vault keys.
entries.summary: The party stole a Salt Guild ledger proving illegal bridge fees. Bromm identified old clan marks in the margin that reference Bell Vault keys.

entries.summary: The party incited merchants against black tariffs and forced Ser Caldus to publicly choose lawful restraint over Iron Court orders. The bridge wardens fractured into loyalist and reform factions.
